commonNames.name: Delacour's Langur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: Delacour's langur or Delacour's lutung (Trachypithecus delacouri) is a critically endangered species of Old World monkey endemic to northern Vietnam. It is named for French-American ornithologist Jean Théodore Delacour.
wikipedia.title: Delacour's langur

wikipedia.extract: Perdicula is a small genus of quail in the family Phasianidae, containing four species that are collectively known as the bush quails.
wikipedia.title: Perdicula

wikipedia.extract: Rhynochetos is a genus of ground-dwelling birds in the monotypic family Rhynochetidae. It contains two species, both endemic to New Caledonia, one of which is extinct.
wikipedia.title: Rhynochetos

commonNames.name: Rufous Mouse Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The brown mouse lemur (Microcebus rufus) is a small primate, and like the other mouse lemurs can only be found on the island of Madagascar. They are known also as the rufous mouse lemur, eastern rufous mouse lemur, red mouse lemur, or russet mouse lemur.
wikipedia.title: Brown mouse lemur

commonNames.name: Bonobo
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The bonobo (; Pan paniscus), also historically called the pygmy chimpanzee (less often the dwarf chimpanzee or gracile chimpanzee), is the smallest species of great ape and one of the two making up the genus Pan (the other being the common chimpanzee, Pan troglodytes). While bonobos are today recognized as a distinct species, they were initially thought to be a subspecies of Pan troglodytes, because of the physical similarities between the two species.
wikipedia.title: Bonobo

commonNames.name: Anhinga
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The anhinga (; Anhinga anhinga), sometimes called darter, American darter, snakebird, or water turkey, is a water bird of the warmer parts of the Americas. The word anhinga comes from a'ñinga in the Brazilian Tupi language and means "devil bird" or "snake bird".
wikipedia.title: Anhinga

commonNames.name: Black-pencilled Marmoset
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The black-tufted marmoset (Callithrix penicillata) is a species of New World monkey that lives primarily in the Neotropical gallery forests of the Brazilian Central Plateau. It ranges from Bahia to Paraná, and as far inland as Goiás, between 14°S and 25°S, and can commonly be seen in the Rio de Janeiro city where it was introduced.
wikipedia.title: Black-tufted marmoset

commonNames.name: tomato
commonNames.source: Database of Vascular Plants of Canada (VASCAN)

wikipedia.extract: The tomato (US: , UK: ; Solanum lycopersicum) is a plant whose fruit is an edible berry that is eaten as a vegetable. The tomato is a member of the nightshade family that includes tobacco, potato, and chili peppers.
wikipedia.title: Tomato

wikipedia.extract: Chlorocebus is a genus of medium-sized primates from the family of Old World monkeys. Seven species are currently recognized.
wikipedia.title: Chlorocebus

commonNames.name: Javan Broadbill
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The banded broadbill (Eurylaimus javanicus) is a species of bird in the typical broadbill family Eurylaimidae found in Mainland Southeast Asia and the Greater Sunda Islands. It is sometimes split into two species, one including only the nominate subspecies, E. j.
wikipedia.title: Banded broadbill

wikipedia.extract: The European rabbit (Oryctolagus cuniculus) or coney is a species of rabbit native to the Iberian Peninsula and southwestern France. It has been introduced to hundreds of locations around the world.
wikipedia.title: European rabbit

wikipedia.extract: Pteroptochos is a genus of birds in the tapaculo family Rhinocryptidae.
wikipedia.title: Pteroptochos

commonNames.name: Equatorial Saki
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The equatorial saki (Pithecia aequatorialis), also called the red-bearded saki, is a species of saki monkey, a type of New World monkey. It is found in northeastern Peru and Ecuador.
wikipedia.title: Equatorial saki
